newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 11.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Australian Broadcasting Corp radio reported on Monday that about 100 passengers on a Qantas flight from Cairns to Japan last week suffered food poisoning. About 20 were admitted to hospital and the outbreak was widely reported in the Japanese press, the ABC reported.

CSR Ltd is expected to report around 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT) on Monday a net profit before abnormals of between A$146 million and A$160 million for the six months to September 30, analysts said on Friday.
Burns Philp holds its annual meeting in Sydney later this morning.

McIntosh Securities, the subject of growing speculation that Merrill Lynch would launch a takeover for the broker, is expected to a make a announcement of the stock exchange on Monday, The Australian Financial Review reported. McIntosh chief executive John McGowan told Reuters on Monday he could not speculate on such reports.

Dutch postal and telecoms firm Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV said on Monday it had extended the closing date of its friendly takeover bid for TNT Ltd to December 3 from November 19. Also the European Commission said on Friday it had cleared the proposed takeover of Australian transport group TNT Ltd by Dutch PTT Post BV.

Flour and stockfeed miller Gibsons Ltd advised on Friday that shareholders take no action on the takeover offer from Pivot Nutrition Pty Ltd, the group's 56.71 percent shareholder. Pivot's proposed offer of A$4.90 cash per share, ex-dividend, is for all of the shares it does not already own.
